hook: One word makes people say yes.
facts: In *1978*, Ellen Langer tested line-cutters at a copy machine.
Just asking to cut in worked *60%* of the time.
Adding 'because I'm in a rush' raised it to *94%*.
Even a weak reason, 'because I need copies', got *93%*.
outro: One word makes people say yes.
